meta.name: Original offline demonstration fixtures
meta.description: Twelve entirely fictional records written for this repository. They are not copied from an upstream dataset and contain no real personal information.
meta.policy_note: R lists users or groups explicitly configured in configs/pilot_groups.json. Listing all three users grants access to those registered users only; it does not permit anonymous or outsider access.
